## Executive result

Summarize the tested scope, overall status, most important failures, and release recommendation. Do not report checks as passed unless they were executed.

## Defects and risks

Describe severity, impact, workaround, owner, and target resolution. Include open dependency and security advisories.

## Environment and limitations

Record browser/device/OS/runtime/network details. Identify untested routes, features, integrations, and assumptions.

## Release recommendation

- [ ] Ready, all required acceptance evidence is present.
- [ ] Ready with documented non-blocking risks and approval.
- [ ] Not ready, blocking failures remain.

Explain the decision and list explicit approvals for accepted risks.
